failure.title: Docker build context and pnpm configuration prevented a clean web build
failure.note: QA-DKR-003 failed because the clean container workspace could not resolve the Next binary; the complete failing protocol report and build log were frozen before changes.
failure.diagnosis: The build context contained recursive generated trees while the container install omitted repository pnpm configuration needed to build the filtered workspace consistently.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
